statement: Lena Fischer reported that the DC-2 feed had failed for the second time that week, on 6 and 14 March 2025.
Lena Fischer's planners worked all morning on Thursday's stock figures without knowing that the DC-2 feed had failed.
fact_key: planner awareness of DC-2 feed failure

statement: Lena Fischer stated that her team over-ordered on about forty lines as a result of the DC-2 feed failure.
fact_key: lines over-ordered after DC-2 feed failure

statement: The DC-2 feed monitoring alerted Kwame Boateng, who was on holiday, and nobody else was watching.
value: Kwame Boateng only, on holiday; no other cover

statement: Lena Fischer recalled that she raised the monitoring cover question with Ana Duarte in January 2025 and was told it would be handled.
value: raised in January 2025; told it would be handled

statement: Ana Duarte acknowledged that Lena Fischer did raise the monitoring cover question and that Ana Duarte did not close it.
value: raised by Lena Fischer; not closed by Ana Duarte

statement: Ana Duarte stated that Tomas Lindholm was covering DC-2 monitoring from 14 March 2025 until Kwame Boateng returned on the 24th.
value: Tomas Lindholm from 2025-03-14 until Kwame Boateng returns on the 24th (March 2025)

statement: Ana Duarte committed to send Tomas Lindholm's number to Lena Fischer separately, noting it was also in the runbook.
value: Tomas Lindholm's number in runbook and to be sent separately

statement: Ana Duarte committed to have a named second person on the runbook permanently by the end of the following week.
Priya Nair stated that the 6 March 2025 failure was a middleware failure on DC-2, the known issue from the April 2024 assessment.
value: middleware failure; known issue from April 2024 assessment

statement: Priya Nair stated that the 14 March 2025 failure was not the middleware: the job ran and moved three files, one of which was empty because an upstream export had not completed, and the job reported success.
value: one of three files empty due to incomplete upstream export; job reported success

statement: Priya Nair asked that the 6 and 14 March failures not be merged into one line in the incident log, because they were two different failure modes with different fixes.
fact_key: incident log treatment of DC-2 failures

statement: Priya Nair committed to implement a file size check for the DC-2 feed job that week as the fix for the 14 March failure mode.
value: to be done this week (week of 2025-03-17)

statement: Tomas Lindholm agreed to record the 6 and 14 March DC-2 failures separately in the incident log.
fact_key: incident log treatment of DC-2 failures
responds_to: Priya Nair's request on 2025-03-17 not to merge the 6 and 14 March failures into one incident log line

statement: Tomas Lindholm asked Priya Nair to go ahead and add the file size check.
responds_to: Priya Nair's proposal on 2025-03-17 to add a file size check to the DC-2 feed job

statement: Tomas Lindholm stated that the file size check should have been in place from the start and that an empty file passing as success was the kind of thing a design review should catch.
fact_key: DC-2 file size check design gap
value: missing from the start; design review should have caught it

statement: Priya Nair reported that the file size check was in place on 21 March 2025.
Priya Nair stated that any file under 1KB now failed the DC-2 feed job loudly.
